invariants.rationale: The method returns exactly the input argument.
If the input writeMetadata is non-null, so is the result; the method does not introduce new nulls.
The result is explicitly a HoodieWriteMetadata, matching the declared return type.
Since the returned object is the exact same as the input, their runtime types are identical.
If HoodieWriteMetadata does not override equals, this is equivalent to identity. Otherwise, it still holds since it's the same object.
